non_reserved_rationale: G11 only materialises and verifies the operator-approved general VIT activation. It adds no packet class beyond the approved normal already-authorised AUTO_EXECUTABLE/AUTO_RATIFIABLE population, changes no programme-owned reserved boundary, preserves the existing serialized SIQ physical gateway and keeps parallel physical merge false.
rollback: Forward-disable general VIT routing and return affected packets to the exact previously-authorised ORCH/SIQ serialized path; preserve all evidence and Git history; never force-push or rewrite history.
